name: The Eiffel Tower grows in summer

hook_variants.template: A building that grows taller every summer. By about 15 centimeters.
What structure grows 15 centimeters taller when it gets hot?
The Eiffel Tower is taller in July than in January.

sections.text: Iron expands with heat. The Eiffel Tower's iron frame grows about 15 centimeters in hot weather.
That's up to 15 cm taller than on a cold winter day.
sections.subtitle: height gain in summer heat

sections.text: It also leans up to 7 centimeters away from the sun as the heated side expands more.
sections.title: it tilts too

sections.text: Engineers leave extra room in the joints so the metal isn't crushed by its own expansion.
sections.title: the fix

sections.text: The main structure is about 300 meters tall — the daily size change is invisible to the eye.
sections.title: Height
sections.label: ~300 m

sections.text: Follow for more facts that make landmarks even cooler.

facts.claim: The Eiffel Tower can expand up to about 15 cm in height due to thermal expansion
The tower leans up to 7 cm away from the sun as the sunny side expands
The tower is made of wrought iron and stands about 300 meters tall
